Persistent notification · more reliable monitoring

No persistent notification or notification permission required. Add FCM Guard to a visible Quick Settings position. When Android binds the visible tile, it can resume the app. Monitoring may pause if the process is frozen or reclaimed; pull down Quick Settings, tap the tile, or open this app to resume. Continuous protection is not guaranteed.
Add Quick Settings tile
Quick Settings wakeup setup

1. Pull down Quick Settings and enter Edit.

2. Find FCM Guard and add it. Place it where it is visible when you pull down the panel.

3. Enable automatic protection in this app. A visible tile gives Android an opportunity to resume monitoring; tap it or open the app if it does not resume.

A lit tile means monitoring is currently running: tap to stop. An unlit tile starts or retries protection. If Shizuku needs attention, tapping opens this app. Long-press opens settings.

This mode has no persistent notification. Process freezing or reclamation can interrupt protection until the app resumes.
